trotzdem.es: a pesar de eso, aun así

texto: With **obwohl** we built a subordinate clause with verb at the end: * Obwohl is kalt ist, trainiert Felix draußen * (Although it's cold, Felix trains outside).

With **trotzdem** we join two main sentences; after «trotzdem» the conjugated verb is necessarily second place: * It is ist kalt; Trotzdem trainiert Felix draußen * (It is cold; despite that, Felix trains outside).

filas: Obwohl es regnet, gehen wir raus.
Es regnet; trotzdem gehen wir raus.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: contrasts with obwohl and Trotzdem

frases.de: Felix, das Wetter ist schrecklich! Gehst du trotzdem zum Training?
frases.es: Felix, ¡el tiempo es espantoso! ¿Vas a pesar de todo al entrenamiento?
frases.en: Felix, time is terrible! You're going to do everything in training?
analisis: Are you going to do everything?

frases.de: Natürlich! Obwohl es kalt ist und stürmt, will ich fit bleiben.
frases.es: ¡Por supuesto! Aunque hace frío y hay temporal, quiero mantenerme en forma.
frases.en: Of course! Although it's cold and there's a temporary, I want to stay in shape.
analisis: I want to stay in shape.

frases.de: Respekt! Ich habe heute keine Lust; trotzdem komme ich gerne mit dir mit.
frases.es: ¡Mis respetos! Hoy no tengo ganas; a pesar de eso te acompaño con mucho gusto.
frases.en: My respects! I don't feel like it today; in spite of that, I am happy to accompany you.

frases.de: Super! Obwohl die Straßen nass sind, macht die Bewegung richtig Spaß.
frases.es: ¡Estupendo! Aunque las calles están mojadas, la actividad física resulta divertida.
frases.en: Great! Although the streets are wet, physical activity is fun.
analisis: Even though the streets are wet

frases.de: Obwohl er müde war, hat er den ganzen Bericht fertiggestellt.
frases.es: Aunque estaba cansado, terminó todo el informe.
frases.en: Although I was tired, the whole report was over.

frases.de: Der Preis ist hoch; trotzdem kaufen viele Leute dieses Produkt.
frases.es: El precio es elevado; no obstante, mucha gente compra este producto.
frases.en: The price is high; however, many people buy this product.

frases.de: Obwohl sie wenig Zeit hat, hilft sie ihren Freunden gerne.
frases.es: Aunque tiene poco tiempo, ayuda a sus amigos con agrado.
frases.en: Although he has little time, he helps his friends with pleasure.

bloques.pregunta: What syntactic position does the verb conjugate after the «trotzdem» orational connector take?

opciones.texto: Second position in the main sentence.
opciones.explicacion: «Trotzdem» acts as an orational link that places the conjugated verb at the second place in the main sentence.
The verb at the end corresponds to «obwohl», not «trotzdem».
The verb follows the connector warning.

bloques.pregunta: What concessional connector would you choose for a sentence where the verb of the first part is left at the end («… es kalt ist»)?

opciones.explicacion: «Obwohl» requires the conjugated verb at the end of its subordinate: «Obwohl es kalt ist, …».
With «trotzdem» the verb would be placed immediately after: «Es ist kalt, trotzdem gehen wir».

bloques.frase: ___ es draußen stark regnet, gehen wir spazieren.

opciones.explicacion: «Obwohl» heads the concessional subordinate and places the conjugated verb at the end.
«Trotzdem» cannot lead a prayer with verb at the end.
It would express cause, not concessional contrast.

bloques.frase: Es regnet stark; ___ gehen die Freunde im Park spazieren.

opciones.explicacion: «Trotzdem» unites the idea as the main connector and immediately precedes the verb «gehen».
With «obwohl» the verb would have to go to the end of the prayer.
«Denn» would explain the cause, not an opposite contrast.

bloques.pregunta: What does this phrase about the person stand out?
bloques.frase: Obwohl sie wenig Zeit hat, hilft sie ihren Freunden gerne.

opciones.texto: His generosity and willingness to help despite his limited free time.
opciones.explicacion: «Obwohl» highlights the merit of collaborating despite the time limitation.

opciones.texto: That he has no friends in his city and he spends the evenings alone.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase says it actively helps your friends.

opciones.texto: It has very short working days.
opciones.explicacion: On the contrary, it indicates that it has little time.

bloques.frase: Das Training ist anstrengend; trotzdem ___ Felix jeden Tag.

opciones.explicacion: After «trotzdem», the conjugated verb occupies the second place in the main clause.
It's the form of plural or infinitive.
It is preterite, while prayer is present.

bloques.frase: Obwohl es kalt ist trainiert Felix
bloques.traduccion: Although it's cold to train Felix
bloques.explicacion: Obwohl + subordinate connector with final verb + coma + main verb + subject.

intro: To contrast two ideas that express an obstacle or difficulty, the German has two fundamental syntactic options: the subordinating conjunction **obwohl** (though, although; I verb to the **final**) and the orational connector **trotzdem** (despite that, even so; verb to **segunda posición**).
